# noderings_ssh_key (Data Source)

Looks up an SSH key by ID, name or fingerprint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name = "laptop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint as reported by NodeRings.
- `id` (String) Key ID.
- `name` (String) Key name (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `key_type` (String) Key algorithm.
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key.
